bias.zh: 偏空 · 收复 200 日均线

read.en: Lumentum rose 8.2% on Oct 26 to $818.10, trading between $756.00 and $840.47. It is above the falling 5-day ($800.0) and rising 200-day ($790.4) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($841.3), 30-day ($939.5) and 100-day ($868.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($936.50), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月26日上涨 8.2%，收于 $818.10，盘中区间 $756.00–840.47。股价位于下行的 5 日（$800.0）和上行的 200 日均线（$790.4）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$841.3）、30 日（$939.5）和 100 日均线（$868.4）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$936.50），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 200-day, $784.5–788.9 and $800–810; the $840.5 high stalled at the 10-day. Resistance is $818.9 (Sep 3 low), then $832–841 (Sep 15 low, 10-day, Oct 26 high) and $868–875 (100-day, Oct 15 and 19 highs). Support is $800 (5-day, Oct 15 low), then $784.5–790.4 and $736–756. A close above $841 would target $868–875; a close below $784.5 would reopen $736–756.

s.en: 200-day average $790.4; Aug 11 and Aug 24 lows ($784.5–787.0), reclaimed
